title: Semidefinite lifts of the perfect matching polytope
description: The shifted matching matrices, with entries |M ∩ δ(U)| − 1 + ρ for odd sets U and perfect matchings M of the complete graph K_n, have positive semidefinite rank 2^{Ω(n)} for every fixed 0 < ρ < 1; consequently every exact semidefinite lift of the perfect matching polytope has exponential size. Averaging row factors over restrictions of cuts to cells, an orthogonal splitting inequality and a Fourier smoothing theorem turn a small factorization into an approximation of a parity function on an expanding graph by squares of low degree, which a functional of Grigoriev type rules out. The course is an exposition of OpenAI's proof (2026), with a further smoothing theorem for averages over perfect matchings.

units.title: The lower bound for perfect matching

prerequisites: finite-dimensional linear algebra: the spectral theorem for real symmetric matrices
basic real analysis: compactness of closed bounded sets in finite dimensions, comparison of sums with integrals

course RT-FIN (Representations of finite groups), lessons The symmetric groups I: Young tableaux and Young symmetrizers (Theorem 4.3, Proposition 5.2 and the Young symmetrizer (5)) and The symmetric groups II: branching, Jucys-Murphy elements and Young's seminormal form (Theorem 4.2 and Corollary 4.3); used only in the seventh lesson
